Class NoOpCommandLogger

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.controller.persistence.NoOpCommandLogger
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameLogger
public class NoOpCommandLogger extends Object implements GameLogger
No-operation GameLogger that silently discards all calls. Used when the real CommandLogger cannot be created (e.g. file-system error), allowing the game to continue without persistence rather than crashing.

Implements the Null Object Pattern.
